page_title: LEV 3-0 KOL | Bayer Leverkusen v FC Koln 08/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+1' Damion Downs (1. FC Koln) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Davie Selke.
90+1' Steffen Baumgart prepares a substitution. Rasmus Carstensen is replaced by Luca Kilian (1. FC Koln).
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
89' The corner from Gustavo Aldolfo Puerta Molano (Bayer Leverkusen) is hurriedly cleared.
88' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Gustavo Aldolfo Puerta Molano (Bayer Leverkusen) comes onto the pitch so that Jonas Hofmann can be given a rest.

86' Max Finkgrafe (1. FC Koln) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the roof of the net. Lukas Hradecky displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
85' Neat passing move from FC Koln in order to create new attacking opportunities.
82' A player from FC Koln commits a rough challenge. Felix Zwayer blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
81' Xabi Alonso has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Adam Hlozek (Bayer Leverkusen) replacing Victor Boniface.
81' Substitution. Jeremie Frimpong makes way for Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen).
80' Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Bayer Leverkusen.
80' The Bayer Leverkusen players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.

78' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and FC Koln will have a goal kick.
77' The FC Koln players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
75' The attendance is 30210.
75' Steffen Baumgart has decided to make a change. Steffen Tigges (1. FC Koln) replaces Eric Martel.
75' Substitution. Denis Huseinbasic makes his way off the pitch and Mathias Olesen (1. FC Koln) comes on as his replacement.
75' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for FC Koln.
74' FC Koln play a few nice passes from player to player, but their possession doesn't last long as an opposition player intercepts a pass. It will be a corner kick for FC Koln.
73' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) strikes a volley towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders blocks his effort.
73' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner but it's cleared.

72' Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Bayer Leverkusen.
71' Xabi Alonso decides to make a substitution. Edmond Tapsoba will be replaced by Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen).
71' Substitution. Florian Wirtz is replaced by Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen).
71' FC Koln can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

69' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Marvin Schwabe inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball into the right side of the target, but was denied by a great save.

67' 3 - 0 GOAL! Superb work from Jonas Hofmann, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen), who beats Marvin Schwabe with a brilliant shot into the left side of the net. 3:0.
66' Xabi Alonso appears to have said too much and referee Felix Zwayer comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.

65' FC Koln slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
62' It will be a substitution. Max Finkgrafe (1. FC Koln) is ready to enter the pitch as Faride Alidou walks off.
61' Jonathan Tah (Bayer Leverkusen) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Felix Zwayer had an easy-decision to make.
60' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from the edge of the box, but it goes just wide of the left post.
60' The corner is swung in but Bayer Leverkusen can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

59' Bayer Leverkusen move the ball around well as they wait for an opportunity to shoot, but the attack is halted as they lose possession. Bayer Leverkusen force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
58' The FC Koln players are exchanging some short passes.

54' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) gets inside the box and tries to beat Marvin Schwabe with a measured shot into the right side of the goal, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
50' FC Koln are playing excellent possession football at the moment by exchanging some long passes.
49' Bayer Leverkusen seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
48' Bayer Leverkusen failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
48' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent. Bayer Leverkusen force their opponents to concede a corner.
47' Bayer Leverkusen are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+4' Felix Zwayer shows a yellow card to Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) for his blatant foul.

45+3' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Lukas Hradecky anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going low into the middle of the target.
45+2' The linesman makes the right call and FC Koln will have a corner.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
43' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) picks up an injury.
43' FC Koln are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. The linesman signals a throw-in for FC Koln.
41' Wonderful movement by Bayer Leverkusen. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
39' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Bayer Leverkusen.
39' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
36' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bayer Leverkusen comes to nothing.

36' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the top left corner and forces a good save out of Marvin Schwabe. Bayer Leverkusen have been awarded a corner kick.
35' Bayer Leverkusen quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
32' 2 - 0 Goal! Alejandro Grimaldo plays a pass to the feet of Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen), and he shoots into the back of the net from inside the box. It's 2:0.
31' Bayer Leverkusen enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
30' Bayer Leverkusen control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
27' Bayer Leverkusen take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
24' Referee Felix Zwayer has finally had enough of Steffen Baumgart and brandishes a yellow card at him!
23' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) is booked for saying more than Felix Zwayer was willing to tolerate.
22' 1 - 0 Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) collects a rebound and hits it precisely into the bottom right corner.
20' Neat passing move from Bayer Leverkusen in order to create new attacking opportunities.
20' The resulting corner from Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) is cleared.

17' Jonathan Tah (Bayer Leverkusen) leaps high deep inside the box to meet a beautiful cross from the resultant free kick. He glances a header goalwards, but it's not accurate and goes narrowly over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for FC Koln.
13' The resulting set piece from Bayer Leverkusen is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

13' A snap shot by Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) from the edge of the area flies towards the left side of the goal, but Marvin Schwabe produces a good save to thwart him. The ball goes behind for a corner. Bayer Leverkusen will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

12' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) doesn't hesitate and begins a run towards the opponent's goal. Defenders try to tackle him, but he manages to keep the ball at his feet and pulls the trigger in front of the goal. The strike, though, was not as successful as the solo run and the ball is easily stopped by the keeper.
11' One of the players from Bayer Leverkusen times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
10' FC Koln get a corner.
10' Corner kick. FC Koln will have an opportunity. An attempted cross from Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) is cleared.
9' Great teamplay by Bayer Leverkusen as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
8' FC Koln hold the ball and are exchanging some long passes.
7' Felix Zwayer blows his whistle. Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) commits a foul after dangerous play. Bayer Leverkusen will take a free kick near the side line.
6' The FC Koln players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
1' The first half has started.
FC Koln will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Felix Zwayer.
